cover.coreProposition: For digital employees, provenance evidence, immediate content utility and durable memory-reuse authority should be separate governance decisions: external-context material may remain visible and useful while memory reuse fails closed, and a pollution state is policy evidence rather than authenticated-source proof or end-to-end safety.
cover.visualMetaphor: A sealed specimen visible through glass while a separate locked channel prevents it from entering a memory archive
cover.semanticObject: One luminous evidence capsule beside a closed archival slot
cover.compositionIntent: Serious landscape editorial cover with a single central object, restrained indigo and warm copper palette, deep negative space and strong thumbnail silhouette
